# Objective

Implement the manifest-defined **CeDG Construction** workspace only after
G9U0, G9U0-R1, G9X1, G9U0-R2, G9U0-R3, G9U0-R4, G9U0-R5 and G9S1 are each
sealed `PASS — AUTHOR APPROVED`.

**DEFINITIVE PROSPECTIVE POST-G9S1 SUCCESSOR — UNEXECUTED / NOT AUTHORIZED.**

This prompt preserves every requirement of
`g9u1-construction-workspace-after-g9u0-r5.prompt.md` and adds the G9S1
semantic-spline surface. The frozen post-R5 prompt has canonical-LF SHA-256
`0b96f571932144f9a99f7681938edf756c8999cb847b61095f82430068e96389`.
This successor supersedes it only after G9S1 PASS and a separate author
authorization of this exact canonical-LF hash. The historical G9P, post-R3 and
post-R5 prompts remain immutable evidence.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

- clean equal local/main/origin/direct-remote state;
- sealed annotated PASS tags, reports and evidence through R5 and G9S1;
- Accepted ADRs 0012, 0016, 0017 and the eventual accepted disposition of ADR
  0018, plus mutually consistent normative workspace/document/Locus/spline
  specifications;
- Classic `Spline` unchanged and `SplineV2` published only through the approved
  semantic `GeoLocusV2` authority;
- `G9-R4-PERIODIC-QUARANTINE-NATIVE-ROUNDTRIP` resolved or still explicitly
  tracked for this gate's required disposition;
- both author brand roles provenance-approved or explicitly under the bounded
  fallback/review policy; and
- separate author authorization of this prompt.

No predecessor PASS automatically authorizes G9U1.

# Scope

The productive scope is the CeDG Construction application profile, its single
manifest/action authority, deterministic product policy, exact-token
intersection presentation/materialization workflow, professional visual
identity and bounded frontend integration of already-approved kernel
capabilities.

## Workspace and action authority

Implement application-profile schema v2, deterministic v1 migration, one
manifest-owned action registry, named workspace/layout/view policy, bottom
input, contextual help, toolbar/menu groups, maturity/feature availability,
localization, accessibility and saved preference behavior.

The professional non-minimal Construction workspace retains all eleven groups:

1. Inspect and construct;
2. Linear geometry;
3. Parameters and drivers;
4. Relations and intersections;
5. Circles, conics and curves;
6. Locus V2 and semantic Spline V2;
7. Metrics and validation;
8. Transformations and manual projections;
9. gated CeDG procedures/developments placeholders;
10. Presentation and document; and
11. Automation and import/export.

Stable action IDs, placement, help, localization, icons, feature requirements
and unavailable policy come from one manifest/action registry. Workspace state
changes discoverability only, never geometry, command semantics, persistence or
feature policy.

Preserve the R3 menu lifecycle, exact-token auxiliary hiding and bounded
inspector layout. The existing Locus V2 opt-in is the only public opt-in for
`SplineV2`; add no intersection/spline/transform-specific flag.

# Architectural placement

Workspace, markers, menus, settings, branding and materialization gestures live
in normal application/frontend seams. Geometry, rich results, selectors,
tokens, reactivation and all metric/intersection truth remain shared-kernel
authority. The frontend may initiate explicit transactions but never solve or
continue roots.

# Required design/specification

Before code, reconcile the accepted application-profile/workspace,
native-document, Locus V2 presentation, deterministic-intersection,
similarity-transform and semantic-spline authorities. Any contradiction with
the post-G9S1 kernel contract is a STOP condition, not permission to broaden it
from the UI.

## Deterministic product policy

GeoCeDG CeDG Construction locks the existing host:

`Continuity = OFF`

This wins over saved preferences, restart, workspace switching, restored UI
state and `.cedg`/compatibility `.ggb` load. Use the existing Kernel
setting/serialization seam; do not add a second field. The Advanced settings UI
cannot enable it. GeoCeDG Classic retains upstream configurability and its
separate preference behavior.

Current deterministic semantic selection outranks a continuity heuristic.
Coordinates, proximity, list/marker order, screen state and movement history
never become identity.

## G9A-compatible free-input redefine

Investigate and implement bounded product UX so an ordinary assignment such as
`k=0.25` can update the explicitly intended compatible numeric through the
approved atomic G9A redefine seam.

- A label may locate the command-context target only; it is never durable
  identity.
- Preserve identity only when the G9A compatibility predicate succeeds.
- Incompatible redefine follows new-identity semantics.
- Ambiguous/nonexistent targets fail closed.
- Undo/redo/save/reopen preserve the graph.
- Characterize Classic separately.

Do not weaken G9A or silently infer identity from a name.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

## Current rich-result markers

`Intersect(L,T)` and one-sided `Intersect(SplineV2(...),T)` keep the rich result
as semantic authority. For the active/selected result only, show presentation-only
markers for current finite point-admissible exact tokens. Markers default ON in
the Construction workspace unless author review changes that preference.

The G9S1 piecewise-polynomial locus×locus capability is rich-only: without a
symmetric certified rectangle+uniqueness selector it has no public continuation
key, active ledger allocation or materializable exact token. Such pair
candidates receive no selectable marker or create-one/selected/all action.
G9U1 must not infer the missing pair identity from caller order, solution
ordinal, coordinates or proximity. A later kernel gate may broaden this only
under a separately approved symmetric certificate/selector contract.

Markers have no GeoElement, ID, XML, DAG, Protocol entry, semantic revision or
token of their own. Stale, dormant, quarantined, overlap-only, unresolved,
ambiguous or inadmissible candidates have no selectable marker. Accessible
presentation must distinguish certified/materializable and nonmaterializable
states without color alone.

Mouse proximity may choose among already established current tokens. It cannot
discover, continue or rank identity. Intrinsic phase/rank/span cells are kernel
authority only; no marker-order identity system exists.

## Materialization workflow

Provide exact-token actions to:

- create the selected point;
- create several selected admissible points; and
- create all currently eligible points.

Each point receives its own current exact token. Multi-create is one visible,
coherent, undoable transaction. Cancel creates nothing.

The inspector remains open for repeated materialization unless explicitly
closed, identifies already-materialized choices, retains keyboard access and
never lets opaque token length size the layout.

An optional auto-materialization policy is an explicit, visible, opt-in
frontend transaction immediately after rich-query creation. It is undoable.
Kernel recompute, load and later root appearance never create a new GeoElement.
Kernel automatic reactivation applies only to an already-existing exact-token
point whose same selector becomes uniquely admissible again.

## Post-R5 and post-G9S1 curve contract

The action registry exposes approved R5 transforms for public semantic Locus V2
including `SplineV2` outputs. A transformed curve remains a semantic
`GeoLocusV2` source for Point, rich length, rich intersection and further
transformations. Transformed queries use new source-pair selectors/tokens.

The `k=0` `COLLAPSED_IMAGE` state may be presented truthfully but must not
fabricate an isolated marker, token or point.

`SplineV2` actions expose only the G9S1-approved public forms and feature policy.
Classic `Spline` remains a separate upstream action/contract. Workspace or UI
code must not evaluate spans, roots or length and must consume only kernel
semantic snapshots/rich results/current tokens.

One-sided spline roots may participate in marker/materialization UX only when
the kernel rich result exposes a current point-admissible exact token.
Spline×spline rich-only diagnostic roots remain inspectable status/evidence,
not point choices.

## Visual identity and brand assets

Define restrained, professional, accessible GeoCeDG frontend identity distinct
from Classic, using normal application seams and reviewable theme/accent
tokens. Presentation changes cause zero Construction/DAG/undo mutation and no
color is semantic authority.

Maintain two provenance-owned logical roles:

- `geocedg.brand.topbar` for frontend/top-bar/product chrome; intended source
  `helixTopBar.png`; and
- `geocedg.brand.startup` for startup/application identity and only after
  suitability checks for frame/package/`.cedg` association derivatives;
  intended source `helixSnapshot.png`.

Record source filename, SHA-256, dimensions, alpha/format and provenance.
Generate required sizes deterministically with tool/version/options recorded;
do not maintain hand-copied packaging duplicates, assume 16×16/32×32
suitability, fabricate absent assets or copy upstream branding. Classic keeps
diagnostic distinction. Final claimed branding/package PASS requires author
asset review where in scope.

# Compatibility and serialization

Preserve `.cedg` native identity, `.ggb` compatibility input, transactional
failed-open behavior, current ZIP/XML and `app="classic"` internals. UI
preferences/markers/chrome do not become geometric XML.

Explicitly execute or obtain author-approved disposition of
`G9-R4-PERIODIC-QUARANTINE-NATIVE-ROUNDTRIP` before the required gate. Do not
infer native quarantine persistence from marker behavior.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

Do not implement G9B, G9C, G9U2 or productive G10. Do not alter R4/R5/G9S1
geometry, add marker semantics to the kernel, make `GeoLocusV2` a generic
`Path`, turn semantic splines into render samples, add a second command/action
registry, fabricate branding or change Classic product policy.

# Required artifacts

Produce the implemented profile/manifest and migration authority, focused
frontend and persistence tests, deterministic evidence and hashes, modified
upstream-file registration, candidate report, validated user/developer guidance
and composed-verifier integration. Generated logs remain under ignored
`artifacts/` only.

# Stop conditions

Stop if workspace/presentation state mutates Construction; markers cannot
remain current-token-only overlays; a rich-only pair candidate would need
frontend-invented identity; Continuity OFF requires a second setting;
free-input redefine requires label-derived identity or non-atomic mutation;
R5/G9S1 semantics would be broadened; the periodic risk is silently ignored;
branding provenance is absent for a claimed final asset; or historical gates
regress.

Stop implementation at:

```text
G9U1 = IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATE — PENDING AUTHOR REVIEW
selfApproved = false
authorApproved = false
passClaimed = false

G9U0-R5 = PASS — AUTHOR APPROVED
G9S1 = PASS — AUTHOR APPROVED
G9B / G9C = NOT AUTHORIZED
G9U2 = BLOCKED
PRODUCTIVE G10 = NOT AUTHORIZED
```
